_comment: Shared fixture pinning ConversationSignals.LooksLikeFalsePremise (C#, shipped) to eval_linus.FALSE_PREMISE (Python, the eval instruments). The two are hand-kept ports of one alternation, so a change to either without the other silently makes the eval measure a different guard from the one the mod injects. Both sides assert against this file. Generated by the gtm training tree; regenerate after any detector change and run both suites.
